input.description: Values for the flow's Start inputs, as an object.
input.title: Input

test.description: true runs the current draft; false runs the latest published version.
test.title: Test

get.description:
Lists what the Marketplace offers: a summary per item, newest version only.

Each entry has the `hash` to send when installing it, and the entries it `requires`. The list
is cached for a few minutes; `stale` is true when the latest refresh failed and this is the
previous copy. 503 `catalog_unavailable` when the catalog cannot be read and nothing is cached.

post.description:
Installs a catalog item in this workspace, or updates it to the given version.

The server fetches the file itself and checks it against `hash`; 409 `hash_mismatch` means the
entry changed since you loaded the index. Items it requires are installed first.

get.description: Lists the Marketplace items installed in this workspace, with their versions.

delete.description:
Removes an installed item. Things already made from it keep their copied settings.

409 `type_in_use` if connections still use a connection type, and 409 `required_by` if
another installed item needs it.

post.description:
Fetches the index again now.

Within 30 seconds of the last attempt the saved copy is returned instead.

get.description: Deployment settings the web app needs.
Lists the connection types you can create, with the fields each one asks for.
Lists the workspace's connections. Secret values are never returned.

post.description:
Creates a connection of a given type.

Its secret fields are encrypted and cannot be read back. It can only be used for the hosts
it allows.

delete.description:
Removes a connection for good.

409 `connection_in_use` lists the flows that use it; `force=true` deletes it anyway.

patch.description: Renames a connection or changes fields. A secret field you leave out keeps its value.

post.description:
Calls the service's check endpoint with the saved credentials.

Only types that have one can be tested, otherwise 422 `no_test_available`. The answer says
whether the service accepted the credentials, and never includes what it sent back.
Stateless helper for the editor's Test pane and validity strip.

get.description:
Explains how a flow graph is written: a guide, the JSON Schema and worked examples.

Read it before saving a draft.

Lists your flows, most recently edited first.

`q` filters by name; `published_version` is null until a flow is published.

post.description:
Creates a flow. Without `draft` it starts as a blank Start to End graph.

It has no published version yet.

delete.description:
Hard mode removes the flow and its runs for good; soft mode only hides the flow.

409 `flow_in_use` lists the flows that call this one; `force=true` deletes it anyway.

get.description:
Returns a flow with its current draft graph and `draft_version`.

Saving the draft needs that `draft_version` as `If-Match`.

patch.description: Renames a flow. Its draft and history are not affected.

get.description: Lists the flows whose latest published version runs this one in a Subflow node.

put.description:
Replaces the whole draft graph.

Send the `draft_version` you last read as `If-Match`; a stale value is 409 `draft_conflict`.
Saves even an invalid graph (autosave); problems are reported by `validate_flow`.

parameters.description: Required: the `draft_version` you last read (from the flow).
parameters.name: if-match

schema.description: Required: the `draft_version` you last read (from the flow).
schema.title: If-Match

post.description:
Validates the draft, then freezes it as the next numbered version.

409 `nothing_to_publish` if the draft has not changed since the last version.

Runs a flow inline: the latest published version, or the current draft with `test: true`.

422 `not_published` if there is no published version. A failure or timeout is a 200 with status
`failed`; bad input is 422; too many runs, 429.

Takes the flow offline: runs and the gateway answer `not_published` until you publish again.

Versions and the draft are kept, and the next publish continues the numbering. 409
`flow_in_use` lists the flows that call this one; `force=true` unpublishes it anyway. 409
`not_published` if it is not published.

Checks the saved draft without publishing it.

Returns `valid: true`, or 422 `invalid_flow` listing each problem with its `node_id`
and `field`.

get.description:
Lists a flow's published versions, newest first.

`keep_latest` is how many are retained.
Returns one published version with its frozen graph.
Process is up. Does not check dependencies.

Lists the ready-made settings for a node, such as an HTTP Request.

The built-in templates plus the ones installed from the Marketplace. A template this server
could not run is left out: its node type is turned off, or its URL points at a host the
server does not allow. Applying one copies its settings into the node; nothing stays linked.
Newest first; pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next page.

Returns one run with its input, output and error.

`get_run_steps` has the step-by-step trace.
Step history from the trace store; `pending` while the trace is still being written.
Lists the workspace's secret names. A value is never returned.

put.description:
Creates the secret, or replaces its value. The value is encrypted and cannot be read back.

Names are uppercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
